title: Unit Event — No seek No find — Episode4 Filled With These Thoughts

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to perform at a new live house to take the next step in their journey. Saki writes a new song to play at the show, but it doesn't seem to resonate with the audience at all...

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what kind of song would resonate the most with the crowd at that live house...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Everyone there seemed totally different from what we're used to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And Shiho said how they were all really calm before the show started instead of being all amped up or excited.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if I tried a quick search on PicShare? Maybe that'll give me a clue as to what they're like...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... I'll try typing the name of that live house into the search bar...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I got a ton of hits!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And everyone's posted comments on their profile page about the shows they've seen and songs they've heard.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I felt really lonely for a few months after moving to Tokyo since I didn't know anybody here, but this venue helped cheer me. All the bands here that play music that really hits home with me.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I was so bored spending another day home alone, but I felt much better after seeing a show here.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, they're all sort of saying the same thing. Is this a place for people to go if they're feeling lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If that's the case, it's no wonder my song didn't really work for them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, if I was feeling down and out, I wouldn't want someone blasting something that's upbeat and really in my face.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I should try writing something that someone in their shoes would want to hear...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How should I reach out to them?
By saying, “You're not alone”...?
Or getting a better understanding of their loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Understanding their loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That reminds me of when...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we engaged with their situation when we wrote that song for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Them having to part ways was sad, but we wanted them to know that they'd be smiling again down the road.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, that's what we genuinely believed. It was our way of showing them our support. We wanted to let them know that we'd be there watching over them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's the only song that Saku seemed sort of okay with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if that wasn't because we wrote it for someone specific...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if it's because we really made an effort to understand their loneliness...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That might be it...
Saku's songs also had the same feel.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like when you're all alone on a cold day but feel this warmth after holding hands with someone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. That must be why everyone was so moved by Saku's songs...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Which means...
I should try to write a song that says, “I know you're lonely”...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I think I have a clear picture now! Let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The song we wrote for Hanano and her brother was about their loneliness after having to go their separate ways...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll try expressing that in a different way this time. I can try exploring what it's like when someone's all alone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All alone...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Saki.
I'll be right by your side tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (Another test tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (I have to do a few every month... But I really wish they'd stop since it always hurts...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line:
Haha!
The teacher was so funny that time!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (It's the kids from the school nearby...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line:
Also, I can't wait for the school trip.
We should try sneaking out at night or something!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student B
rows.Line: But we'll get in big trouble if the teachers catch us.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student C
rows.Line: We won't get caught as long as we're quiet. We can grab some ice cream and hang out together!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: They look my age...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
The school trip.
I wish I could go... With Ichi and everyone...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (When's the last time I actually got to hang out with them...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line: (I wanna chat more and go on trips with them...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student A
rows.Line: Let's have lots of fun and create a lot of memories together!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Student B & C
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
No fair...
They look like they're having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... Things weren't easy then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As much as I wanted to be with everyone else, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try to reach out to them by expressing how I felt back then...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The first verse can be about feeling lonely... I can try giving the chorus an uplifting sound, and the third verse will be like...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought I had a clear idea as to what to do... But at this rate, the finished product might not be very good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It feels... Superficial?
Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll keep trying a little more...!
The next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I came up with a bunch of ideas, but none of them really made me go, “Eureka!”)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Saki...?
You seem awfully tired. Did you not get enough sleep last night...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yeah!
I'm totally fine, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Ichi!
Hope your class rep meeting went okay♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all here, let's do our debrief for yesterday's show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As I mentioned yesterday, we need to work on both our music and how we perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like for us to focus on both heading into our next show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...
I thought a lot about what to do in terms of our music...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we want to reach the people at that live house, I think we need to come up with a song that really shows that we understand why they're feeling lonely...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understanding why they feel lonely...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, but what exactly led you to this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I tried remembering what everyone there looked like and even did a quick search on PicShare. Based on the results I saw, I discovered that a lot of people who go there are ones who feel pretty lonely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I asked myself, “What kind of song would hit home with them?” That's how I arrived at really trying to understand what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
You started with getting a feel for their mood.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, Saki might be right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The reason they all liked anemone so much may've been because of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You think so too, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I wanna try writing a song that has the same sort of effect!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble actually doing that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, Saki, you don't usually write somber songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because writing bright and cheerful songs makes me feel really happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the song you wrote for Hanano and her brother sort of had a somber tone, so I'm sure you'll figure this out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also thought a lot about how or why we were able to write that song for Hanano and her brother.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is just my hunch...
But I think it's because their situation reminded me of what I went through way back when and wanted to show them my support somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What you went through way back when?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
When I couldn't see any of you and felt really lonely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to cheer past me up by saying, “It's gonna be okay!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
H-Huh?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
For not visiting you more back then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It must've been so hard being all alone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh no...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That's okay because you're all here now! We're in a band together and I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That may be true, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You don't need to apologize!
I'm okay now, really!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, turn those frowns upside down!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Again, I'm totally fine because you're all literally right here with me! We can chat whenever and I can hug you all like this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so warm, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-You're squeezing too tight.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe!
You too, Ichi! C'mere!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're all smiling again. Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And I'm so glad that we're able to be together like this...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “It's okay because we're together now”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if I tried working something like that into my song?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like it.
It's very you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree, and I have a feeling that we'll put on a much better performance if we know we're doing it for your past self.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I should be able to write a really good song now...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for talking things out with me! I'm gonna start working on it right away after I get home!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Talking things out?
To be honest, you did most of the talking just now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We're very much looking forward to hearing your new song, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, everyone!
